pendingReviewBacklog.title: Solid–vapor synthesis of dynamic crystalline one-dimensional supramolecular polymers from amorphous macrocycles
pendingReviewBacklog.evidenceGap: Full publisher abstract or body/SI showing macrocycle/guest variation, reproducible solid–vapor assembly scope, and whether the synthesis controls a transferable chain/architecture feature rather than one target material.
pendingReviewBacklog.evidenceNeeded: Full publisher abstract or body/SI showing macrocycle/guest variation, reproducible solid–vapor assembly scope, and whether the synthesis controls a transferable chain/architecture feature rather than one target material.
pendingReviewBacklog.nextAction: Use the existing browser/VPN evidence path to read the article abstract or relevant preparation section; do not infer generality from the listing teaser.
pendingReviewBacklog.evidenceBasis: The fresh compact has no abstract. A same-day Nature Communications research listing describes a highly dynamic crystalline supramolecular polymer made by a unique solid–vapor host–guest-driven synthesis. That establishes more than a title keyword, but not the article-specific generality required to decide whether this is in-scope polymer synthesis methodology or target-specific responsive-material assembly.
pendingReviewBacklog.challengeReason: It cannot be excluded merely as a material because polymer assembly is the principal synthetic act, and true polymer/architecture-control methods may qualify. It also cannot be included from one publisher teaser without preparative breadth. Both passes therefore defer this DOI only.

pendingScopeReviewBacklog.title: Protonation-Gated Strain-Release Generation of Amino-o-quinodimethanes
pendingScopeReviewBacklog.evidenceBasis: The ACS repository abstract now confirms protonation-controlled amino-BCB ring opening, a >50 kJ mol−1 barrier shift, >10^3-fold kinetic window and rapid [4+2] trapping, but gives no trapping-partner/product breadth.
pendingScopeReviewBacklog.challengeReason: The work may be a useful reagent-activation method, yet the available abstract is dominated by kinetics and reactive-intermediate control. Without product/preparative scope, a final mechanism-only exclusion or method inclusion would both overclaim.

pendingScopeReviewBacklog.nextAction: Read the reaction/scope table through the existing browser/VPN path; retain the current card until resolved.

pendingScopeReviewBacklog.title: Synthesis of a Fully Functionalized Chasmanine AF-Ring Fragment
pendingScopeReviewBacklog.evidenceBasis: The publisher title and ACS repository excerpt establish an expedient synthesis of a fully functionalized Chasmanine AF-ring fragment, but not a completed total synthesis or a broadly reusable building-block route.

pendingScopeReviewBacklog.evidenceNeeded: Full abstract/route evidence, synthetic generality beyond the single target fragment, and the preserved original date from authoritative production data.
pendingScopeReviewBacklog.nextAction: Read the route/abstract through the existing browser/VPN path; keep the card unchanged and do not label it total synthesis.
